_comments.execution: Stage only: 3 banks x 3 horizons x 6 situations = 54 jobs. Run explicitly with --run.
_comments.pairing: Same Jan/Feb evaluation windows, Audi vehicles/seeds and initial states as the scenario-count study. Freeze one trace per seed across all nine combinations and both months. Reserve the largest bank and 48-hour twin forecast tail before selecting a feasible source anchor; do not assume exact replay anchors match older studies.
_comments.horizon_hours: Top-level 24 hours reserves the largest forecast tail. Per-configuration horizon_hours and forecast_hours jointly override it with 6, 12 or 24 hours.
_comments.forecast: Five equally weighted paths, tod_dow_state_hier, 14/21/28-day completed historical bank, non-overlapping selected trajectories, four persistent 15-minute prefix intervals. Actual selected counts and backoff remain diagnostic outputs.
_comments.objective: MILP electricity + departure comfort (1000) + SOC health (1000) + daily-minimum terminal energy; trip slack weight 10000. No OCP degradation term. Reference physical SOH evolution remains active. Persistence, cycle caps, dwells and discharge budgets off.
_comments.scope: GUROBI defaults, existing physical battery/load settings, V2H enabled, HPWH/HVAC baseline. Initial SOC 0.4; 24-hour warmup + 120-hour evaluation + 24-hour cooldown. Warmup/cooldown excluded from all scored metrics.
_comments.outputs: One paired_metrics row per bank/horizon combination. Average only matched situations, never bank/horizon levels or V2H/non-V2H cases. Heatmaps show savings, service/aging, forecast quality and computation. Forecast error across different horizons has different target coverage; inspect score counts.
_comments.reuse_all_baseline: Reuse only all-baseline plant trajectories with identical physical/mobility/comfort inputs and code/runtime fingerprints. Recompute metrics and keep complete outputs in every job. Non-V2H twins and advanced controls always run independently.
